objective: Desarrollar y certificar la capability atomica API_LOCAL_EMPRESA_HOMOLOGATION. No ejecutar ninguna homologacion real. La capability debe permitir exclusivamente ConexionID + EmpresaID, exigir confirmacion y preflight/post-audit SQL READ_ONLY, validar API_LOCAL activa y EmpresaID actual NULL, y mutar unicamente EmpresaID mediante helper canonico. Prohibir secretos, URL, database, ServerID, UnidadNegocioID, activo y cualquier otro campo.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, asyncio, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
BACKEND = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(BACKEND) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND))
from core.server_registry import _get_server_by_id_from_sql, update_server
UUID_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$")
def main() -> int:
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--connection-id",required=True)
    p.add_argument("--empresa-id",required=True,type=int)
    p.add_argument("--confirm",action="store_true")
    a=p.parse_args()
    if not UUID_RE.fullmatch(a.connection_id): print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"CONNECTION_ID_INVALID"})); return 2
    if a.empresa_id <= 0: print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"EMPRESA_ID_INVALID"})); return 2
    if not a.confirm: print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED"})); return 2
    before=_get_server_by_id_from_sql(a.connection_id,include_inactive=True)
    if not before: print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND"})); return 3
    if before.get("tipo_conexion")!="API_LOCAL": print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"NOT_API_LOCAL"})); return 4
    if not bool(before.get("activo")): print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"CONNECTION_INACTIVE"})); return 5
    if before.get("EmpresaID") is not None: print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"EMPRESA_ID_NOT_NULL"})); return 6
    result=asyncio.run(update_server(a.connection_id,{"empresa_id":a.empresa_id}))
    if not result.get("success"): print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":str(result.get("error") or "UPDATE_FAILED")})); return 7
    after=_get_server_by_id_from_sql(a.connection_id,include_inactive=True)
    if not after: print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"POST_UPDATE_NOT_FOUND"})); return 8
    if after.get("EmpresaID") != a.empresa_id: print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"POST_UPDATE_EMPRESA_MISMATCH"})); return 9
    if after.get("tipo_conexion")!="API_LOCAL" or not bool(after.get("activo")): print(json.dumps({"status":"FAIL","error":"POST_UPDATE_IDENTITY_CHANGED"})); return 10
    print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS","connection_id":a.connection_id,"empresa_id_after":after.get("EmpresaID"),"active_preserved":True,"type_preserved":True,"secrets_exposed":False}))
    return 0
if __name__=="__main__": raise SystemExit(main())

from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BRIDGE=ROOT/"tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py"
DISPATCHER=ROOT/"tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_dispatcher.py"
SCRIPT=ROOT/"backend/scripts/update_api_local_empresa.py"
def test_capability_is_declared_and_closed():
    b=BRIDGE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"); d=DISPATCHER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "API_LOCAL_EMPRESA_HOMOLOGATION_MODE" in b
    assert "API_LOCAL_EMPRESA_HOMOLOGATION_MODE" in d
    for forbidden in ("api_key","password","secret","api_url","database_name","server_id","unidad_negocio_id"):
        assert forbidden in b
def test_helper_is_atomic_and_api_local_only():
    s=SCRIPT.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert 'before.get("tipo_conexion")!="API_LOCAL"' in s
    assert 'before.get("EmpresaID") is not None' in s
    assert 'update_server(a.connection_id,{"empresa_id":a.empresa_id})' in s
    assert "api_key" not in s.lower()
